title: Personal Loans Refinance-Purpose Quotes: Interest Day Rates Around an AutoPay Change
content:
## Rule

On a refinance-purpose payoff quote of a Personal Loans loan, the rate each interest day carries is the rate in force that day, read from the loan's latest AutoPay enrollment and latest AutoPay cancellation (when both fall on the same date the enrollment is the later record):

1. when only the latest cancellation is dated after the interest paid-through date, the days from the paid-through date to the cancellation date (a count of days between two dates being the later date minus the earlier) carry the current interest rate less the grade's AutoPay discount;
2. when only the latest enrollment is dated after the paid-through date, the days from the paid-through date to the enrollment date carry the current interest rate plus the grade's AutoPay discount;
3. when both are dated after the paid-through date and the cancellation is the earlier record, the days from the cancellation date to the enrollment date carry the current interest rate plus the grade's AutoPay discount;
4. when both are dated after the paid-through date and the enrollment is the earlier record, the days from the enrollment date to the cancellation date carry the current interest rate less the grade's AutoPay discount;
5. every other interest day carries the current interest rate.

The quoted interest is worked out once over all its interest days, each at the rate it carries, and rounded to the cent only at that point.

| AutoPay discount by grade | A | B | C | D | E | F | G |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| points | 0.50 | 0.50 | 0.50 | 0.25 | 0.25 | 0.25 | 0.25 |

## Cases (hypothetical Personal Loan Grade B loan, interest paid through 1 May, current rate 12.00 percent)

| Latest AutoPay records | Days at a different rate | Their rate |
|---|---|---|
| cancellation 11 May, enrollment in January | 10 (1 May to 11 May) | 11.50 |
| enrollment 8 May, cancellation in January | 7 (1 May to 8 May) | 12.50 |
| cancellation 4 May, enrollment 9 May | 5 (4 May to 9 May) | 12.50 |
| enrollment 4 May, cancellation 9 May | 5 (4 May to 9 May) | 11.50 |
| cancellation and enrollment both 6 May | 0 | - |
| both dated before 1 May | none | every day at 12.00 |

In the first case, of the quote's interest days 10 carry 11.50 and the rest carry 12.00.
